name: Tippy Dam Recreation Area Campground
evidence: DNR TippyDamCampMap.pdf: sites 1-40 line a road under Upper River Rd, set back from the backwaters, with 'steps to backwater' off the loop. Esri z18: hardwood canopy. DEM: loop 232-238 m vs water 207 m (bluff). midnrreservations: no site tagged Adjacent To water. Upstream of the dam, so the bluff and canopy decide.

name: Tomahawk Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri + Wayback z19 (2017-2023, 0.21 m/px) at 45.2303,-84.1660: loop roads 35-70 m from the north shore. Nearest road is ~35-40 m back behind a pine band, with no legible pad inside 25 m. The open sand shore is the central shared beach/picnic area. Campers sit north of the road. 'Some sites have direct access' is prose; no per-site map.

name: Upper Manistee River State Forest Campground
evidence: Our pin was on the entrance road ~350 m NW. OSM way 939333172 + Wayback z19: the drive-in loop (campers) is at 44.7473,-84.8372, ~35+ m from the river behind trees. The NE riverside clearing is DNR's walk-in/paddle-in group area. DNR: river reached by staircase/footpath, '50 yards' from the site 5 lot. No per-site map.

name: Van Etten Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Our pin was on private lakefront homes ~200 m NW, so moved to the OSM site + 45 pitches. Esri 0.27-0.36 m/px: lakeside row pads ~55-65 m from shore through sparse trees, with the boat-launch lot between at the west end. DEM: terrace above the 178 m lake. DNR 'sites 36-46 reach the lake via footpaths' = set back. Kept lakeview.

name: Trout Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Wayback z19 2018/2024 (pre-drawdown high-water edge): knoll loop (OSM rel 16794289) beside the dam's west abutment, lake side. Sandy pad clearings ~10-22 m from the north shore and east bay, campers ~20 m. DEM: loop 319 m vs pool 313 m, not below the dam. Per the gate the 2025 drawdown doesn't downgrade.

name: Tomahawk Creek Flooding State Forest Campground
evidence: Our pin was a creek crossing ~800 m N, so moved to the east unit (OSM 2920898945). Esri 0.29 m/px: east-unit pads end ~45-70 m from the flooding through jack pine. West unit (45.2127,-84.1849): pads ~30-40 m back behind trees, with the launch/turnaround as the shore use. No per-site map.

name: Twin Lakes State Forest Campground
evidence: Wayback z19 leaf-off 2024-11 (0.21 m/px) at 45.5370,-84.2890: an 11-site loop on the peninsula, ~35-40 m above-and-back from Twin Lake's west shore behind a conifer fringe; a footpath runs to the dock. DEM: loop 226-230 m vs lake 205 m (DNR 'forested bluff'). No per-site map. Kept lakeview.

name: Trailway Campground
evidence: Esri z18 (0.24 m/px) at 43.4162,-86.3528: pads between the grocery lot and the Hart-Montague rail-trail. East of the trail and a tree band is White River marsh; nearest open pool ~50 m+, channel ~150 m+. White Lake's marina is south across Dowling St/buildings. Trail and treeline are a used buffer.
